Markets.title: M&A deals double, but execution holds the key for investors: Crisil Ratings
Markets.summary: India's annual mergers and acquisitions volumes have more than doubled since fiscal 2017 due to companies pursuing growth and market expansion. Crisil Ratings found that two-thirds of major debt-funded acquisitions met expectations, while integration and regulatory challenges impacted the rest.

Markets.title: Sensex falls 183 points, Nifty closes below 24,250 as market erases all morning gains. What lies ahead?
Markets.summary: The Indian stock markets reversed early gains, with the Sensex falling 183 points and the Nifty closing below 24,250. Key declines in stocks like Infosys, Bharti Airtel, and L&T drove the downturn, despite gains in Kotak Mahindra Bank and small-cap segments.

Markets.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $79K ahead of US PCE, GDP Data; whales book record $1.2 billion profit in 3 days
Markets.summary: Bitcoin traded near $79,000 on Wednesday as the market awaited upcoming U.S. GDP and PCE inflation data. Meanwhile, short-term whales locked in a record $1.2 billion in profits over three days, introducing caution that could limit near-term gains.

Markets.title: Adani’s Cemindia is said to near up to $524 million share sale
Markets.summary: Adani Group-backed Cemindia Projects is preparing a share sale to raise up to Rs 5,000 crore. The company has hired ICICI Securities and SBI Capital Markets to advise on the potential transaction.

Markets.title: Global Market: Mexico’s ‘Super Peso’ rally puts exporters under pressure
Markets.summary: Mexico's peso has strengthened past 17 per dollar in 2026, becoming one of the best-performing emerging-market currencies. While this "super peso" helps lower inflation and import costs, it creates financial pressure for exporters who depend on US revenue.

Markets.title: Global Market: ECB may raise rates in September as Iran war fuels inflation concerns: Reports
Markets.summary: The European Central Bank is leaning toward a September rate hike because the Iran conflict is driving up energy prices and inflation. Officials are hesitant to signal further tightening beyond September and will base future decisions on incoming economic data.

Geo-Political.title: Seventeen dead and hundreds unaccounted for as flash flood hits Nepal-Tibet border
Geo-Political.summary: A flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border in Rasuwa has left 17 people dead and hundreds unaccounted for. The disaster is feared to have swept away entire villages north of Kathmandu.

Geo-Political.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on American goods, including steel, furniture, fresh tuna, and makeup. This move marks a significant escalation in the ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada.

Geo-Political.title: Libyan who was cleared after Lockerbie bombing trial dies aged 70
Geo-Political.summary: Al Amin Khalifah Fhimah, a Libyan national who was cleared in the 2001 Lockerbie bombing trial, has died at the age of 70. His death was announced in a Facebook post by Libyan Airlines, which offered condolences to his family.

Geo-Political.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
Geo-Political.summary: Far-right Israeli lawmaker Zvi Sukkot used a sledgehammer to damage a Palestinian memorial. His actions drew widespread condemnation, including criticism from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's Merz warns attackers will 'pay price' after drone incident
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that attackers will pay a price following a drone attack on Leipzig Airport. He stated that the incident highlights the very real threat currently facing the country.

Geo-Political.title: Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit
Geo-Political.summary: An Indian jewellery advertisement featuring actor Kriti Sanon celebrating the Hindu festival of Rakhi was pulled following public backlash over her outfit. Sanon has defended the commercial amid the criticism.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result for a relevant user query without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is changing organic traffic compared to traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.title: India’s GDP growth likely slowed to a 4-quarter low of 7.4% in Q1: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's GDP growth is projected to slow to a four-quarter low of 7.4% in the first quarter, according to a Mint poll. While industrial and services sectors supported the economy, agricultural activity likely declined due to a delayed monsoon.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: Why does Niti Aayog want to change India’s skilling system?
Data & Insights.summary: Niti Aayog has proposed combining India's education and training into a single system to prepare workers for future jobs by 2047. This new framework shifts the primary focus from basic certification to securing actual employment.

Data & Insights.title: How India’s import dependence is spilling beyond oil, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: India's non-petroleum trade deficit is surging beyond crude oil due to a growing reliance on foreign electronics components and industrial inputs. This trend highlights that the country remains dependent on assembly rather than deep domestic manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: VCs look past payment figures to spot 'dead users' hiding in UPI autoPay metrics
Data & Insights.summary: Venture capitalists are analyzing underlying app engagement rather than relying solely on UPI autoPay transaction volumes. This deeper evaluation helps investors identify dormant subscribers and determine the actual market value of startups.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal offers BIS exemptions to high-tech chipmakers, AI firms to boost ‘Make in India’
Data & Insights.summary: Minister Piyush Goyal has granted Bureau of Indian Standards exemptions to semiconductor and artificial intelligence companies to prevent delays in establishing operations in India. This policy change addresses concerns previously raised by Japanese firms regarding existing certification requirements.

Data & Insights.title: India plans 100 new ships to cut $75 billion foreign freight bill
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to add 100 new ships to its fleet to reduce its $75 billion foreign freight bill. This expansion addresses a major financial hurdle, as operating under the Indian flag is currently 16-20% more expensive than operating under foreign flags.

India.title: Opinion: Opinion | The General Who Survived Iran's Wildest Battles: Meet Ahmad Vahidi
India.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei appointed Ahmad Vahidi as the new chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) this month. Vahidi is a long-surviving military leader with extensive experience in the regime's purges, sanctions, and major wars.

India.title: Kangana Ranaut's "Bro, Wait" Post To Rahul Gandhi's "Smash Patriarchy" Call
India.summary: Actor and politician Kangana Ranaut criticized Rahul Gandhi's "smash patriarchy" social media campaign. Ranaut claimed that Gandhi is using women's issues for political leverage while ignoring his own party's history.

India.title: IIT Kanpur Professor To Receive National Teachers Award, Institute Celebrates
India.summary: An IIT Kanpur professor will receive the National Teachers Award following online nominations submitted through the Rashtriya Puraskar Portal. The institute is celebrating this recognition.

India.title: Ek-Uttarakhand Top Cop Exits Panel Probing IIT Delhi Student's Death Amid Row
India.summary: A former Uttarakhand top cop has withdrawn from the panel investigating the August 22 death of IIT Delhi student Rishikesh Kumar amid a row. Kumar died after falling from the sixth floor of the campus's Lecture Hall Complex.

India.title: Meet Shaivee Malik, 25-Year-Old IIT Delhi Graduate Helping Reduce Food Waste
India.summary: Twenty-five-year-old IIT Delhi graduate Shaivee Malik co-founded Yotuh Energy to help reduce food waste. The company developed a lithium-ion battery-powered refrigeration system for transport trucks.

India.title: "He Said 'Mummy, I Am Hurting'": Mother Of IIT Student Who Died By Suicide
India.summary: An IIT student died by suicide after previously telling his mother that he was hurting and having suicidal thoughts. His brother, Abhishek Kumar, confirmed that Rishikesh had confided in their mother about his mental state.

General.title: Murder probe as two people dead in house fire
General.summary: Cleveland Police launched a murder investigation after two people died in a house fire near Middlesbrough. Authorities stated they cannot rule out potential connections to wider organized crime.

General.title: Prince Harry and Meghan due to arrive in UK today
General.summary: Prince Harry, Meghan, and their two children are scheduled to arrive in the UK today. The family is traveling privately on a flight from California.

General.title: From 'dirt poor' to philanthropic superstar - the life of Dolly Parton
General.summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80, the singer's team announced on social media.

General.title: Cosmic radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
General.summary: Former Air France stewardess Sophie Lainault has had her cancer recognised as an occupational disease.

General.title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
General.summary: A household using a typical amount of gas and electricity will pay £60 a year more, regulator Ofgem says.

General.title: Why Pride is facing a backlash - from inside and outside the LGBT community
General.summary: Big companies used to go out of their way to support Pride. Now, there's a nervousness in the air, Darren Milby writes
